text:
ros: Quick doc sync: we need a very short migration note for v1->v2 focusing on two things: embedding model swaps (dim incompatibility) and the SDK param rename from `embed_model` to `model_id`. Goal: single page, TL;DR, two tiny snippets, and a PR checklist. Deadline: next week.
sam: I can write the TS snippet + mini smoke test. will show a defensive guard using EXPECTED_DIM and falling back to a pinned stable model.
anya: Ill take the banner and the "what to expect" bullets. legal prefers 'recommend' instead of 'must'.
miguel: I'll do the Python snippet and add an assert for vector length in the example. runtime note: service doesn't remap vectors; if dims change, you need to reindex or keep the old model.
ros: keep wording user-friendly. product wants a one-liner for the in-product banner: "Embedding lengths may change after model swaps; reindexing is recommended."
anya: draft banner: "Notice: /v1/models deprecated; retire date 2026-04-15. Swapping embedding models can change vector lengths — we recommend reindexing or pinning model IDs to avoid search drift."
sam: TS sketch (very small):
```ts
// guard: prefer pinned model when dims mismatch
const meta = await client.models.get('embed-v2')
if (meta.embedding_dim !== EXPECTED_DIM) {
  await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-v1-pin', input: ['hello'] })
} else {
  await client.embeddings.create({ model: meta.id, input: ['hello'] })
}
```
miguel: Py sketch:
```py
meta = client.models.get('embed-v2')
model_id = meta['id']
if meta['embedding_dim'] != EXPECTED_DIM:
    vecs = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-v1-pin', input=[text])
else:
    vecs = client.embeddings.create(model=model_id, input=[text])
assert len(vecs[0]) == EXPECTED_DIM
```
anya: page outline: TL;DR banner, quick bullets (what changed + rollout rec), 2 snippets, smoke test note, links (reindex guide + samples), PR checklist. Keep prose under ~250 words.
ros: PR checklist for docs reviewers:
- add page under sidebar "deprecations"
- include banner copy and i18n keys
- include both snippets and a tiny test harness (node18 + py3)
- add links to reindex guide and examples repo
- run smoke tests and add results to PR comments
- label issue with docs-migration
i18n-bot: Reminder: mark translatable strings with keys and include source strings in PR description. deadline for translations: 2026-03-31.
sam: I'll open branch docs/migration/embed-swap-mini tomorrow. ping @anya when PR ready for copy review.
anya: also add a short FAQ line: "Does runtime convert vectors?" Answer: "No. Reindex or pin models." Keep it terse.
miguel: small implementation note: when dims change, clear any cached embeddings and validate downstream pipeline shapes. adding that to 'what to expect'.
ros: final assignment: sam = PR owner (snippets + tests), anya = copy + banner, miguel = sample python snippet + confirm behavior, ros = merge coordination and in-product banner. timeline: draft PR by Tue, review Wed, merge by 2026-03-25 to allow i18n.
sam: on it. will add tiny smoke test that asserts vector length.
anya: posting banner + bullets in channel in ~30m.
docs-bot: Don't forget to add the docs-migration label when creating the issue/PR.
ros: thanks all. short and sharp.
